strings.zh: 捉虫大会内{NEWLINE}汇聚了来自全国各地的{CLEAR}虫精灵爱好者！{SCROLL}你说我？{NEWLINE}我最怕虫精灵了。
strings.en: The Bug-Catching Contest brings{NEWLINE}together Bug-type Pokémon lovers from{CLEAR}all over the country!{SCROLL}...Me? I’m terrified of Bug-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon.
strings.notes: US 0389/0 | RV039: addition: I heard was added

strings.zh: 捉虫大会的召开日是……{CLEAR}星期二、星期四、星期六。{SCROLL}不仅可以参加,{NEWLINE}抓住的虫精灵{CLEAR}还可以归自己哦。
strings.en: The Bug-Catching Contest is held on{NEWLINE}Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.{SCROLL}Not only can you take part,{NEWLINE}you also get to keep the Bug-type{CLEAR}Pokémon you catch.

strings.zh: 不好意思把你留下来。{SCROLL}那边是口袋竞技会场{NEWLINE}入口大门,{CLEAR}不过还没造好。{SCROLL}突击工程明白么？{NEWLINE}就是紧急进行施工啊。{SCROLL}马上就要开放了,{NEWLINE}敬请期待吧。
strings.en: Sorry to hold you up.{SCROLL}Over there is the entrance gate to the{NEWLINE}Pokéathlon Dome, but it isn’t finished{CLEAR}yet.{SCROLL}You know what a rush job is? It means{NEWLINE}urgent construction work.{SCROLL}It’ll be opening soon, so look forward{NEWLINE}to it.
strings.notes: US 0389/2 | RV039: meaning: aligned to zh

strings.zh: 这里是口袋竞技会场{NEWLINE}入口大门,{SCROLL}请各位踊跃参加吧！
strings.en: The Pokéathlon Dome is this way.{SCROLL}Please go through the entrance gate,{NEWLINE}and do participate in the games!

strings.zh: 啊啊啊！{NEWLINE}口袋竞技还没开始啊~！{SCROLL}哇,等不及了？{NEWLINE}那就绕城都地区跑１周！
strings.en: Arrgh!{SCROLL}When is the Pokéathlon going to{NEWLINE}be ready?{SCROLL}I can’t just sit here and wait!{NEWLINE}I’ll go on an around-Johto run!

strings.zh: 好！等的就是这个时刻！{SCROLL}让你们看看{NEWLINE}我和精灵的友情！
strings.en: I’ve been waiting for this moment!{SCROLL}Behold my friendship with my Pokémon!

strings.zh: 要只是和精灵一起跑跑,{NEWLINE}我或许也能参加吧。
strings.en: I wonder if I can participate, too.{NEWLINE}It’s only running with Pokémon, right?

strings.zh: 和精灵齐心协力,{NEWLINE}与精灵相互信赖,{CLEAR}相信精灵的可能性,{SCROLL}用友情抓住明天！{NEWLINE}来吧,你也来口袋竞技！
strings.en: Work together with your Pokémon, trust{NEWLINE}each other, and believe in your{CLEAR}Pokémon’s potential!{SCROLL}Seize tomorrow with friendship! Come on,{NEWLINE}join the Pokéathlon too!
strings.notes: US 0389/7 | RV039: meaning: US said make your dream come true

strings.zh: 友情的补充能量！{NEWLINE}给精灵“运动饮料”。
strings.en: Charge your energy with friendship!{NEWLINE}Give Aprijuice to your Pokémon!

strings.zh: 口袋竞技场的重新装修总算完成了,{NEWLINE}终于可以闲下来好好看看{CLEAR}口袋竞技运动员们的精彩表现了。
strings.en: The Pokéathlon Dome renovation is{NEWLINE}finally done.{SCROLL}Now I can relax and enjoy{NEWLINE}watching the athletes’ amazing{CLEAR}Pokéathlon performances.

strings.zh: 哦哟哟哟！{NEWLINE}前面在施工呢,{CLEAR}非常危险啊。{SCROLL}过几天就能通过了,{NEWLINE}敬请期待吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Whoa, whoa, whoa! There’s construction{NEWLINE}up ahead. It’s very dangerous.{SCROLL}You’ll be able to get through in a few{NEWLINE}days, so look forward to it.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0389/10 | RV039: meaning: aligned to zh
